# SimpleLogin Provider

Manage [SimpleLogin](https://simplelogin.io) email aliases and their forwarding mailboxes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    simplelogin = {
      # Always use the full address: in OpenTofu a short "qnimbus/simplelogin"
      # would resolve to registry.opentofu.org instead.
      source  = "registry.terraform.io/qnimbus/simplelogin"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# Reads the API key from SIMPLELOGIN_API_KEY.
provider "simplelogin" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) SimpleLogin API key, created under *API Keys* in the SimpleLogin dashboard. May also be set with the `SIMPLELOGIN_API_KEY` environment variable, which is the recommended way.
- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the SimpleLogin instance, without the `/api` path. Defaults to `https://app.simplelogin.io`. May also be set with the `SIMPLELOGIN_BASE_URL` environment variable. Useful for self-hosted instances.
